Unofficial white-border recreation for [[Son Of Skywalker (Revised)]] using earlier black-border wording. It is not a scan of a physical white-border card or a faithful transcription of the documented physical Revised specimen.

== Provenance ==
* Source face: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010904235130id_/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/images/sonofskywalker.gif Decipher.com black-border card GIF], Wayback capture 4 September 2001 (367 × 506 pixels). The capture date is not a claimed card publication date.
* Illustration comparison: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=38 Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], PDF page 38. This illustration and the black-border GIF have the older “any starship” and “here ... directly” wording, which differs from the photographed physical white-border specimen.
* Physical-printing comparison: [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 PSA collector gallery], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/179117643/qARmcotEKkCgVwV4vP6iuw.jpg photographed card front]. The pictured Revised specimen instead reads “anything he pilots” and “during your deploy phase”, with deployment “on Luke (for free)” and “reshuffle”.

== File details ==
Crop the source rectangle (left 3, top 3, right 353, bottom 493; right and bottom exclusive) to the 350 × 490-pixel printed-card bounds. Apply the Premiere white-border recipe at 4× scale: NEAREST upscale, a 14-pixel outer ring and 10-pixel corner radius measured at final size, rounded masks blurred by 1.2 pixels at 4× scale, white border and transparent exterior corners, then LANCZOS downsampling to 350 × 490 RGBA PNG. The whole face is resampled; pixel identity with the source is not claimed. Wording, lore, statistics, icons and copyright are not redrawn.
